messages:
marta: Quick thread — Helionix ops story runbook. We need: recorded interview (APAC/EU customer), one short quote about latency + cost, legal approval of benchmark claims, and a webinar (30-35m). Can we land by EOW?

sam: Can we do the interview before Thu? Need 30m recording + 15m buffer. I'll draft Qs and an asset checklist.

raj: Webinar preference: Wed 11am PT to cover ANZ mornings and EU afternoons. Who will own the registration page and expected capacity?

marta: Proposed interview times sent via invite: Tue 08:00 GMT / Tue 20:00 AEST / Wed 16:00 PT. calendar-bot: Event created: "Helionix case interview (30m)" — invites sent to alex_cs, marta, sam, helionix-contact.

alex_cs: Helionix confirmed Tue 08:00 GMT. They've asked to include the benchmark chart showing ~3x throughput and ~40% lower cost per token vs their prior stack.

sam: Drafting narrative. Question: marketing, prefer absolute metrics or relative statements in the quote? Relatives usually easier for customers to sign off.

jules: Legal needs the raw test logs, methodology writeup, and customer signoff on any numeric claims. Typical turnaround ~48 hours after we get artifacts. Also need logo use consent.

marta: Alex — can you request the logs, short methodology note, and a written OK on chart language from Helionix? I'll prepare the suggested quote language.

sam: Quote candidate (please edit):

"Switching to Redwood Inference reduced our inference costs by ~40% and improved median latency by 3x, enabling us to ship real-time features faster."

raj: For lead routing: registration form should tag leads with "webinar: Helionix" and route to growth + SDR queues. Also send an immediate follow-up email with a short case excerpt and CTA to book a demo.

marta: Raj — can you wire the webhook to our HubSpot/Drift flow and add the webinar tag? Need lead routing tested before signup opens.

raj: Will scope the webhook and run test events tomorrow.

jules: If the quote contains specific percentages and latencies, include this clause in the release: "Customer consents to public use of performance comparisons derived from logs they submit, and Redwood Inference may reproduce associated charts and summary statistics." Drafting release now.

marta: Timeline recap:
- Today: calendar confirmed (Alex) + Sam drafts Qs and quote snippet.
- Tomorrow: Alex collects logs + written consent from Helionix.
- +48 hours after logs: Jules to approve benchmark language.
- Fri: Marketing finalizes blog draft + webinar registration page; Raj completes lead routing.

sam: I'll attach the interview prep doc with Qs and ping design for chart mockups. :thumbsup:

alex_cs: Helionix asked for a one-pager with suggested exec talking points. I'll attach post-call.

marta: Actions assigned. If anyone can't meet timeline, flag here. Otherwise I'll start a PR draft and webinar copy for review. :eyes: 

calendar-bot: Reminder set: "Helionix case interview" in 48 hours.
